findings.issue: The reviewer suspected staged additions were filtered using the old Git mode.
findings.disposition: Refuted. Git raw output puts the new mode at field 1, and a real initial commit warned.

findings.issue: The current HEAD comparison differs from an amended commit's historical parent.
findings.disposition: Documented the staging baseline. Pre-commit exposes the effective index and no amend flag.

findings.issue: An incomplete scan with no classified snapshots hid a capture-health warning.
findings.disposition: Combined both findings on the bounded advisory line when the staged scan has no classified warning.

findings.issue: The manual's amend wording could imply the health advisory was also quiet.
findings.disposition: Clarified that the rule concerns snapshot warnings.

findings.issue: One run of the linked worktree's invalid-state fixture emitted the wrapper unavailable line.
findings.disposition: Repeated isolated runs passed for the parent and reviewer. A single wrapper fallback under contention remains an observed limit.

findings.issue: A worktree directory replacement could hide an unchanged staged blob.
findings.disposition: Read the configured literal path in the index independently of a replaced working directory.

findings.issue: An unreadable private path could prevent staged snapshot classification.
findings.disposition: Treat unavailable local state as optional for staged classification.

findings.issue: Staged Git inspection lost the commit's alternate object storage context.
findings.disposition: Retain the effective commit object settings for both cached diff and blob reads.

findings.issue: An unassociated competing store could make an exact discard appear ambiguous.
findings.disposition: Require a matching worktree association before a competing registration affects discard.

findings.issue: A missing state setting could prevent inspection despite an explicitly enabled advisory.
findings.disposition: Read the selected local advisory preference independently of optional state.

findings.issue: A malformed registration could be accepted through a partial SQL projection.
findings.disposition: Decode bounded registration evidence and leave discard unconfirmed on failure.

findings.issue: Lexical cleanup could select an unrelated directory across symlink parent traversal.
findings.disposition: Use physical placement for parent-traversal paths in shared and private settings.

findings.issue: A parseable registration with no identity could still suppress a staged warning.
findings.disposition: Require decoded identity to match indexed source, store and session.

findings.issue: SQLite character length could let an oversized text registration bypass the byte cap.
findings.disposition: Measure BLOB byte length before returning the record. The hook regression fails with the old query.

findings.issue: A broad discard lookup could pass the original fixture.
findings.disposition: Test unrelated same-worktree capture and enroll the linked worktree in the same registry.

findings.issue: Malformed JSON alone did not test byte and candidate ceilings.
findings.disposition: Add deterministic Git size, cancellation and candidate-budget tests.

findings.issue: Worker setup could time out before the commit-index oracle.
findings.disposition: Use portable snapshots written directly in the fixture, with real installed hooks and capture registers.

findings.issue: Malformed sibling snapshots masked count truncation and no assertion protected cumulative bytes.
findings.disposition: Use only valid snapshots and assert exact-bound complete and over-bound partial results. Each test failed under its targeted mutation.
